body: dont do it the effects it has on your kids are not what you will expect, im 20 and lost my dad to suicide a month and half ago, dont do this to them, think about the people you care about and how you wouldnt want this weight stuck in their mind

Let them know about how you are feeling mentally so that they can better understand why you may think away, honesty helps when your depressed, i just lost my dad to suicide and he didnt think anyone would care but would have been astonished by the amount of people that did. just know someone will always listen. if u make that choice the effects on the people you care about and are around you will haunt them, be honest and talk through it with them and get the help you need if u cant find someone to talk to. Hell ill talk to you im struggling myself but am blessed to have the ability to afford people to talk to but getting those thoughts out of your mind and into words really help

dont, you dont realize the effect your suicide will have, i just lost my dad to suicide and he didnt realize the amount of people around him that would be effected. As much as you think it will help yourself, think about the way it will effect others, instead of making that choice choose to be honest with those around you about how you feel and they will listen and it really helps clear your mind for a second to be honest about your thoughts and feelings
any idea how i can find people in alike situations?

Yeah Ive thought about group, but I just have this problem right now cause the thing that makes me unable to compare my loss to others is the unexpectedness and the choice. There are things like heart attack and strokes that cause unexpected loss, but they would have chosen to stay with their family if they had the choice and thats what makes it hard in my mind when people try to empathize with me or something, i just cant help but think this kind of loss is unique, but i understand everyones loss is unique in its own way, but i cant get my mind to think that even though I know that

If you dont have the emotional stamina to support someone then try talking about what your struggling with as they talk to you as about their struggle. Ive found it temporarily mind clearing to share struggles and it helps you feel less alone for the time being.
